chunks: Certainly, this is the rebellious group, in which is the near one (Zubayr), the scorpion's venom ('A'ishah), and the doubt that casts a veil (on facts). And the matter is clear, and the falsehood has been shaken from its foundation, and its tongue has ceased from its mischief. By Allah, I will not let their cistern be drained; I am the one who controls it. They will not draw from it with ease, nor will they drink from it after it is finished.

key_terms.الشُّبْهَةُ الْمُغْدِفَةُ: The doubt that casts a veil

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali mean by the 'rebellious group' and the 'cistern' in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) characterizes the coalition of Talha and Zubayr as the 'rebellious faction' (al-f'iyyah al-baghiyyah), employing specific metaphors to critique Zubayr's volatility and A'ishah's influence. He declares the collapse of their false claim to authority, using the metaphor of the 'hawd' (cistern) to assert his exclusive right to command and control the flow of leadership, ensuring they cannot easily access or disrupt it.
